decision.observation: This is the pink-coral/shell-mosaic chamber again, now seen from above after exiting the hub's top-right cave mouth. Hornet stands behind the tall dark pillars near center-right; the pink coral cluster juts from the right wall at (~0.77, 0.36), with green glow dots floating in the dark above and to the right.
decision.hypothesis: The pink coral cluster may itself be a landable ledge/platform rather than scenery. Jumping from the pillar tops onto the coral could reach an upper ledge where the green glows sit.
decision.memory: Hub's top-right cave mouth connects into this pillar/coral chamber from above. Coral never tested as a landing platform, only struck.
